74: fn get_syntax_mapping_to_paths<'a>(
75:     mappings: &[(GlobMatcher, MappingTarget<'a>)],

77:     let mut map = HashMap::new();
78:     for mapping in mappings {

80:             let globs = map.entry(*s).or_insert_with(Vec::new);

87: pub fn get_languages(config: &Config) -> Result<String> {
88:     let mut result: String = String::new();
89: 
90:     let assets = assets_from_cache_or_binary(config.use_custom_assets)?;
91:     let mut languages = assets
92:         .get_syntaxes()?
93:         .iter()
94:         .filter(|syntax| !syntax.hidden && !syntax.file_extensions.is_empty())
95:         .cloned()
96:         .collect::<Vec<_>>();
97: 
98:     // Handling of file-extension conflicts, see issue #1076
99:     for lang in &mut languages {
100:         let lang_name = lang.name.clone();
101:         lang.file_extensions.retain(|extension| {
102:             // The 'extension' variable is not certainly a real extension.
103:             //
104:             // Skip if 'extension' starts with '.', likely a hidden file like '.vimrc'
105:             // Also skip if the 'extension' contains another real extension, likely
106:             // that is a full match file name like 'CMakeLists.txt' and 'Cargo.lock'
107:             if extension.starts_with('.') || Path::new(extension).extension().is_some() {
108:                 return true;
109:             }
110: 
111:             let test_file = Path::new("test").with_extension(extension);
112:             let syntax_in_set = assets.get_syntax_for_path(test_file, &config.syntax_mapping);
113:             matches!(syntax_in_set, Ok(syntax_in_set) if syntax_in_set.syntax.name == lang_name)
114:         });
115:     }
116: 
117:     languages.sort_by_key(|lang| lang.name.to_uppercase());
118: 
119:     let configured_languages = get_syntax_mapping_to_paths(config.syntax_mapping.mappings());
120: 
121:     for lang in &mut languages {
122:         if let Some(additional_paths) = configured_languages.get(lang.name.as_str()) {
123:             lang.file_extensions
124:                 .extend(additional_paths.iter().cloned());
125:         }
126:     }
127: 
128:     if config.loop_through {
129:         for lang in languages {
130:             writeln!(result, "{}:{}", lang.name, lang.file_extensions.join(",")).ok();
131:         }
132:     } else {
133:         let longest = languages
134:             .iter()
135:             .map(|syntax| syntax.name.len())
136:             .max()
137:             .unwrap_or(32); // Fallback width if they have no language definitions.
138: 
139:         let comma_separator = ", ";
140:         let separator = " ";
141:         // Line-wrapping for the possible file extension overflow.
142:         let desired_width = config.term_width - longest - separator.len();
143: 
144:         let style = if config.colored_output {
145:             Green.normal()
146:         } else {
147:             Style::default()
148:         };
149: 
150:         for lang in languages {
151:             write!(result, "{:width$}{}", lang.name, separator, width = longest).ok();
152: 
153:             // Number of characters on this line so far, wrap before `desired_width`
154:             let mut num_chars = 0;
155: 
156:             let mut extension = lang.file_extensions.iter().peekable();
157:             while let Some(word) = extension.next() {
158:                 // If we can't fit this word in, then create a line break and align it in.
159:                 let new_chars = word.len() + comma_separator.len();
160:                 if num_chars + new_chars >= desired_width {
161:                     num_chars = 0;
162:                     write!(result, "\n{:width$}{}", "", separator, width = longest).ok();
163:                 }
164: 
165:                 num_chars += new_chars;
166:                 write!(result, "{}", style.paint(&word[..])).ok();
167:                 if extension.peek().is_some() {
168:                     result += comma_separator;
169:                 }
170:             }
171:             result += "\n";
172:         }
173:     }
174: 
175:     Ok(result)
176: }
